items.name: Cboe Predicts prediction-markets suite
items.claim: Cboe launched the first products in its new prediction markets suite, Cboe Predicts, including binary option contracts based on the Mini-S&P 500 Index (XSP) listed under the symbols XSPBW and XSPBX, now available on Interactive Brokers and expected to roll out at Charles Schwab in the coming months.
items.source_excerpt: The offering includes binary option contracts based on the Mini-S&P 500 Index (XSP), listed under the symbols XSPBW and XSPBX. The contracts are now available on Interactive Brokers and expected to roll out at Charles Schwab in the coming months, with additional retail brokerage platforms expected to offer access over time. Cboe Predicts SM represents the latest expansion of Cboe's S&P 500 Index (SPX) product suite.

notes: Stored web_doc from Cboe's own investor-relations press release covers the June 2026 Cboe Predicts launch, its first prediction-markets product. No RPO/backlog figure disclosed in the stored text.
